description: This file contains implementation of bounds overlap analysis functions for tensor expressions, including comparison, overlap detection, and subtraction of bounds and index bounds.

classes.name: Bound
classes.description: Represents a boundary with start and end expressions for tensor index bounds.

methods.name: mustBePositive
methods.description: Checks if an expression is guaranteed to be positive.

methods.name: mustBeNegative
methods.description: Checks if an expression is guaranteed to be negative.

methods.name: mustBeZero
methods.description: Checks if an expression is guaranteed to be zero.

methods.name: Bound::equals
methods.description: Checks if two bounds are equal.

methods.name: Bound::operator==
methods.description: Checks if two bounds are equal, considering simplified difference.

methods.name: Bound::operator!=
methods.description: Checks if two bounds are not equal.

methods.name: Bound::operator>=
methods.description: Checks if this bound is greater than or equal to another.

methods.name: Bound::operator>
methods.description: Checks if this bound is strictly greater than another.

methods.name: Bound::operator<=
methods.description: Checks if this bound is less than or equal to another.

methods.name: Bound::operator<
methods.description: Checks if this bound is strictly less than another.

methods.name: boundOverlap
methods.description: Determines the overlap kind between two bounds.

methods.name: compareBound
methods.description: Compares two bounds with a specified comparison operation.

methods.name: indexBoundsEquals
methods.description: Checks if two index bounds vectors are equal.

methods.name: flattenBounds
methods.description: Flattens multi-dimensional index bounds into a single Bound.

methods.name: overlaps
methods.description: Determines the overlap kind between two index bounds.

methods.name: subtractBound
methods.description: Subtracts one bound from another, returning remaining segments.

methods.name: subtractIndicesBounds
methods.description: Subtracts one set of index bounds from another, considering overlap.
